# Toolkit

Toolkit is a lightweight collection of useful slash commands for World of Warcraft.

It has no external libraries, no configuration UI, and no background processing. The addon simply registers a handful of convenience commands.

## Commands

| Command | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/leaveparty` | Leaves your current party or raid. When inside an instance, Toolkit leaves the instance group. |
| `/disbandgroup` | Removes the other members of your current party or raid, then leaves the group. |
| `/rl` | Reloads the World of Warcraft user interface. |
| `/fs` | Opens Blizzard's Frame Stack tool for inspecting UI frames. |

## Notes

Group-changing commands do nothing while the player is in combat, where Blizzard restricts this functionality.

`/disbandgroup` can only remove players that your character has permission to remove.

## Compatibility

Version 12.002 adds World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (interface 16001) support through `Toolkit_Camelot.toc`. The default `Toolkit.toc` retains the World of Warcraft 12.1 target.

Install the complete `Toolkit` folder, including both TOC files, in your Forever client's `Interface/AddOns` directory. Restart the client after installing.

Forever compatibility has been reviewed against published client/API notes but still needs in-game verification. Check `/rl`, `/fs`, `/leaveparty`, and `/disbandgroup` in a disposable test group, including party and raid membership. Group commands should do nothing during combat.
